dishes.description: Crispy and chewy pork intestines stir-fried with chili peppers and spices, offering a rich and savory flavor with a kick.

dishes.name: Sichuan Boiled Beef
dishes.description: Tender slices of beef cooked in a fiery broth with a generous amount of chili oil, Sichuan peppercorns, and vegetables, creating a numbing and spicy sensation.
dishes.story: This dish is famous for its 'numbing and spicy' (麻辣 - málà) flavor profile, a hallmark of Sichuan cuisine. Despite its name, the beef is not simply 'boiled' but rather poached in a rich, spicy oil-based broth.

dishes.name: Chongqing Chili Chicken
dishes.description: Crispy, bite-sized pieces of chicken stir-fried with a mountain of dried red chilies, Sichuan peppercorns, and aromatic spices, delivering a fragrant and spicy flavor.
dishes.story: A classic Sichuan dish where the chicken pieces are often 'hidden' among the many dried chilies, making it a fun challenge to find them.

dishes.name: Zhuge Grilled Fish
dishes.description: A whole grilled fish, often served in a large tray with a rich, spicy broth and various vegetables, inspired by the legendary strategist Zhuge Liang.
dishes.story: Named after Zhuge Liang, a brilliant strategist from the Three Kingdoms period, this dish is said to have been his favorite. It's known for its complex, aromatic, and spicy flavors.

dishes.name: Sizzling Beef Platter
dishes.description: Tender slices of beef stir-fried with onions and peppers, served on a sizzling hot iron plate to keep it warm and aromatic.

dishes.name: Sour Cabbage Black Fish
dishes.description: Slices of black fish cooked in a tangy and savory broth with pickled mustard greens, creating a refreshing and slightly spicy flavor.

dishes.name: Sizzling Frog Legs
dishes.description: Frog legs stir-fried with spices and vegetables, served on a sizzling hot iron plate.

dishes.name: Sichuan Boiled Pork Slices
dishes.description: Tender slices of pork cooked in a fiery broth with a generous amount of chili oil, Sichuan peppercorns, and vegetables, creating a numbing and spicy sensation.
dishes.story: Similar to Sichuan Boiled Beef, this dish features pork slices prepared in the same iconic numbing and spicy broth.

dishes.name: Spicy Fragrant Frog Legs
dishes.description: Frog legs stir-fried with a fragrant blend of chili peppers, spices, and aromatics, delivering a rich and spicy flavor.

dishes.name: Home-Style Braised / Sweet and Sour Field Fish
dishes.description: Field fish prepared either in a savory home-style braise or with a classic sweet and sour sauce.

dishes.name: Sichuan Boiling Fish
dishes.description: Slices of fish cooked in a large bowl of boiling hot chili oil and broth, topped with dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns for an intense numbing and spicy flavor.
dishes.story: The name 'Boiling Fish' refers to the method of pouring hot oil over the fish and spices just before serving, creating a dramatic sizzling effect and releasing intense aromas.

dishes.name: Cumin Beef
dishes.description: Stir-fried beef seasoned heavily with cumin, chili flakes, and other spices, offering a fragrant and savory flavor with a hint of spice.
dishes.story: This dish shows influence from Xinjiang cuisine, where cumin is a prominent spice, often used with lamb and beef.

dishes.name: Sichuan Boiled Frog Legs
dishes.description: Tender frog legs cooked in a fiery broth with a generous amount of chili oil, Sichuan peppercorns, and vegetables, creating a numbing and spicy sensation.

dishes.name: Preserved Vegetable Omelet
dishes.description: A savory omelet made with eggs and chopped preserved mustard greens, offering a unique salty and umami flavor.

dishes.name: Kelp Salad with Scallion Oil
dishes.description: Refreshing strips of kelp tossed in a fragrant scallion oil dressing, a light and savory cold starter.

dishes.name: Eggplant with Fried Dough Sticks
dishes.description: Stir-fried eggplant combined with crispy pieces of Chinese fried dough sticks, offering a unique texture and savory flavor.

dishes.name: Enoki Mushrooms with Scallion Oil
dishes.description: Delicate enoki mushrooms dressed in a fragrant scallion oil, a simple yet flavorful cold dish.

dishes.name: Kung Pao Chicken
dishes.description: Diced chicken stir-fried with peanuts, dried chili peppers, and Sichuan peppercorns in a savory, sweet, and tangy sauce.
dishes.story: A world-famous Sichuan dish, named after Ding Baozhen, a Qing Dynasty official who was the governor of Sichuan Province. 'Gong Bao' was his official title.

dishes.name: Crispy Corn Pancake
dishes.description: A sweet and crispy pancake made from corn kernels, often deep-fried to a golden perfection.

dishes.name: Fish-Fragrant Potatoes
dishes.description: Shredded potatoes stir-fried in a classic 'fish-fragrant' sauce, which is savory, sweet, sour, and spicy, despite containing no fish.
dishes.story: The 'fish-fragrant' (鱼香 - yúxiāng) flavor profile is a staple of Sichuan cuisine, characterized by a balance of savory, sweet, sour, and spicy notes, traditionally used for cooking fish.

dishes.name: Imperial Tofu
dishes.description: Tofu prepared in a rich and flavorful sauce, often with minced meat or mushrooms, fit for an emperor.

dishes.name: Fish-Fragrant Pork Shreds
dishes.description: Shredded pork stir-fried with wood ear mushrooms, bamboo shoots, and peppers in a classic 'fish-fragrant' sauce that is savory, sweet, sour, and spicy.
dishes.story: This is one of the most famous Sichuan dishes, showcasing the versatile 'fish-fragrant' flavor profile with pork.

dishes.name: Twice-Cooked Pork
dishes.description: Slices of boiled pork belly stir-fried with broad bean paste, sweet bean sauce, and vegetables, offering a rich, savory, and slightly spicy flavor.
dishes.story: 'Twice-cooked' refers to the pork being first boiled and then stir-fried, a technique that renders the fat and deepens the flavor.

dishes.name: Salted Egg Yolk Sweet Potato
dishes.description: Sweet potato pieces coated in a rich and savory salted egg yolk sauce, offering a unique blend of sweet and umami flavors.

dishes.name: Sizzling Taro Platter
dishes.description: Taro pieces cooked and served on a sizzling hot iron plate, often with a sweet or savory sauce.

dishes.name: Crispy Aromatic Pork Ribs
dishes.description: Pork ribs marinated and deep-fried until golden and crispy, offering a savory and aromatic flavor.

dishes.name: Stir-fried Bean Sprouts
dishes.description: Simple and refreshing stir-fried bean sprouts, often with garlic and a light seasoning.

dishes.name: Stir-fried Frog Legs
dishes.description: Fresh frog legs quickly stir-fried with ginger, garlic, and chili peppers, offering a tender texture and savory flavor.

dishes.name: Dry Pot Pork Intestines
dishes.description: Pork intestines stir-fried with vegetables and spices in a dry pot, offering a rich, savory, and spicy flavor that stays hot at the table.
dishes.story: 'Dry pot' (干锅 - gānguō) dishes are similar to hot pot but without the broth, allowing ingredients to caramelize and absorb more flavor from the spices.

dishes.name: Dry Pot Cabbage
dishes.description: Cabbage stir-fried with chili peppers, garlic, and savory seasonings in a dry pot, offering a slightly spicy and aromatic flavor.

dishes.name: Stir-fried Beef with Chili
dishes.description: Tender slices of beef stir-fried with chili peppers, garlic, and other seasonings, a popular Hunan-style dish known for its spicy and savory taste.
dishes.story: This dish is a staple of Hunan cuisine, famous for its bold and spicy flavors.

dishes.name: Candied Sweet Potato
dishes.description: Deep-fried sweet potato pieces coated in a crispy, caramelized sugar syrup, served with a bowl of cold water to create a 'pulling silk' effect.
dishes.story: 'Básī' (拔丝) means 'pulling silk,' referring to the long, thin strands of caramelized sugar that form when you pick up a piece of the candied fruit or vegetable.

dishes.name: Braised Crucian Carp
dishes.description: Whole crucian carp braised in a rich, savory, and slightly sweet sauce, a classic home-style dish.

dishes.name: Sweet and Sour Pork Tenderloin
dishes.description: Crispy pieces of pork tenderloin coated in a vibrant sweet and sour sauce, a classic and popular Chinese dish.

dishes.name: Candied Banana
dishes.description: Deep-fried banana pieces coated in a crispy, caramelized sugar syrup, served with a bowl of cold water to create a 'pulling silk' effect.
dishes.story: Similar to candied sweet potato, this dessert is known for its fun 'pulling silk' presentation.

dishes.name: Salt and Pepper Pork Tenderloin
dishes.description: Crispy pieces of pork tenderloin seasoned with a savory and aromatic salt and pepper mix.

dishes.name: Dry Pot Chicken
dishes.description: Chicken pieces stir-fried with vegetables and spices in a dry pot, offering a rich, savory, and spicy flavor that stays hot at the table.

dishes.name: Salt and Pepper Cauliflower
dishes.description: Cauliflower florets lightly battered and fried, then seasoned with a savory and aromatic salt and pepper mix.
